title: Planning and turnout points
hook: Two stated cases: explore the denominators behind an absolute turnout gap.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the denominators behind an absolute turnout gap affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the denominators behind an absolute turnout gap in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
